headline: investingLive Americas FX news wrap 31 Aug: The USD moves lower. USD corrects after Warsh's hawkish speech at Jackson Hole
summary: The US dollar closed lower despite higher yields, correcting after Federal Reserve chair nominee Kevin Warsh gave a hawkish speech at Jackson Hole. Oil rose and stocks fell but recovered from lows.
why: The dollar's direction against major currencies affects global portfolio returns, commodity prices and emerging-market funding costs. Jackson Hole is the Federal Reserve's annual policy symposium, closely watched for signals on interest rates.
why_moved: Hawkish remarks from Warsh pushed yields higher, but the dollar still closed lower in the session. Oil rose and equities dipped before recovering some losses.
